GETTING STARTED/Introduction

Give your agents memory.
Keep the evidence.

Build with MESA, the evidence-aware memory infrastructure for AI agents. Ingest sources, retrieve scoped context, and trace every assertion back to its origin.

YOUR FIRST STEP

Start building with MESA

Install v0.9.0, run mesa start, then add and search a document. BM25 works without a model.

Open the quickstart

Memory is useful when you can follow it back to the source. MESA keeps that connection through the full lifecycle.
